projectShortDescription: Python Boilerplate contains all the boilerplate you need to create a Python package.

__prompts__.fullName: Your full name -- free text. Lands in LICENSE + pyproject authors. e.g. Nicholas Bergantz
__prompts__.email: Your email -- pyproject authors / PyPI contact. e.g. you@example.com
__prompts__.githubUsername: GitHub username or org (lowercase) -- builds repo + issue URLs. e.g. kopecn
__prompts__.projectName: Human-readable title -- free text, Title Case OK. Used in README/docs headings. e.g. Python Boilerplate
__prompts__.projectIdentifier: Distribution + top-folder name. PEP 8/503: lowercase snake_case, NO hyphens. Becomes pyproject [project].name (PyPI) + the project folder. e.g. python_boilerplate
__prompts__.packageName: Import package. PEP 8: short, all-lowercase snake_case. Becomes src/<packageName>/ -- you `import <packageName>`. e.g. my_package
__prompts__.moduleName: Module file. PEP 8: lowercase snake_case. Becomes src/<packageName>/<moduleName>.py. e.g. my_module
__prompts__.projectShortDescription: One-line summary -- free text. Lands in pyproject [project].description.
__prompts__.pypiUsername: PyPI username (lowercase) -- defaults to your GitHub username.
__prompts__.version: Initial version, PEP 440 (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH). Lands in pyproject [project].version. e.g. 0.0.1
__prompts__.ghIdentifier: Derived 'owner/repo' for GitHub URLs -- accept the default.
